text: 全球债市再遇抛售！激进加息周期担忧是否会兑现 市场目前定价显示，美联储、欧央行、英国央行三大央行未来一年将至少加息三次。
text_en: Global bond markets face sell-offs again! Will concerns over an aggressive rate hike cycle materialize? Current market pricing shows that the Federal Reserve, ECB and Bank of England will raise rates at least three times in the next year.
